name: Arcane Armor Training
benefit:
As a swift action, reduce the arcane spell failure chance due to the armor you are wearing by 10% for any spells you cast this round.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 114
When casting a spell while wearing armor, you can spend 1 stamina point to activate Arcane Armor Training as a free action.
flavor: You have learned how to cast spells while wearing armor.
text:
